name: dev.pages.hodoyoku/japan-data
title: Hodoyoku Japan data
description: Japan visa work check, instant & deep web research, monitors, quakes, JMA warnings. x402.

tools.name: get_japan_ticket_drops
tools.description: Upcoming official Japan ticket, anime/manga, and food reservation openings in JST. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: get_japan_business_calendar
tools.description: Official Japan national holidays and typical government and bank closures, in JST. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: get_japan_weather_warnings
tools.description: Active official JMA weather warnings and advisories for one Japan forecast office, in English. Changes through the day. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402. Use office code or area name; call list_japan_warning_offices first if needed.

area.description: English or Japanese area name, e.g. Tokyo

tools.name: get_japan_minimum_wage
tools.description: Official Japan regional minimum wage (JPY/hour) in force on a date (JST) for one prefecture, or all 47 if pref is omitted. Handles staggered FY2026 effective dates and returns the next pending revision plus overtime/night premium rules, with MHLW source URLs. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

pref.description: JIS code 1-47 (e.g. 13) or English/Japanese name (e.g. Tokyo, 東京都). Omit for all 47.

tools.name: get_japan_worker_rights
tools.description: Know-before-you-work data for foreign workers in Japan: minimum wages, labour rights with e-Gov law citations (premiums, passport retention, wage payment), native-language help desks, and job-change rules by visa status. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: quick_japan_research
tools.description: Instant Japan web research (lite): short cited answer to a Japan-related question in the same call. Costs 0.03 USDC via x402. For a detailed report use start_japan_web_research (0.12 USDC).

urls.description: Optional up to 3 public https source URLs

tools.name: check_japan_visa_work
tools.description: Japan status of residence (visa) x occupation work-eligibility lookup from official Immigration Services Agency pages: residence-card work label, permitted activities, official example jobs, Specified Skilled Worker fields, and part-time permission rules (28 h/week). Source URLs and fetched_at included. Not legal advice. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

status.description: Status of residence id or name, e.g. engineer_humanities_international, Student, 留学, SSW, permanent resident. Omit with occupation to find matching statuses.

occupation.description: Job in English or Japanese, e.g. interpreter, truck driver, 介護

hours_per_week.description: Optional planned hours per week (for permission-based part-time work)

tools.name: get_japan_earthquakes
tools.description: Recent felt earthquakes in Japan from official JMA reports, in English: time (JST), epicenter, magnitude, depth, max seismic intensity (shindo) and per-prefecture intensity. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

pref.description: Optional prefecture: JIS code 1-47 or English/Japanese name (e.g. Tokyo)

tools.name: check_japan_earthquake_impact
tools.description: Batch check whether recent official JMA earthquake shaking reached a threshold at your Japan sites. Pass up to 50 prefectures or 7-digit JMA city codes, optionally labeled (HQ:Tokyo,Plant:Aichi); omit for all 47 prefectures. Returns per-site status none/felt/check/severe, max intensity and strongest event. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

sites.description: Comma-separated sites, e.g. HQ:Tokyo,Plant:Aichi,27,4320500. Omit for all 47 prefectures.

threshold.description: JMA intensity that counts as impact: 1, 2, 3, 4 (default), 5-, 5+, 6-, 6+, 7

tools.name: start_japan_web_research
tools.description: Start an async Japan web-research job. Costs 0.12 USDC via x402. Returns a job_id immediately; poll with get_japan_web_research. The Worker fetches public Japanese sources (Wikipedia plus optional URLs you provide) and summarizes them with Workers AI.

urls.description: Optional, up to 3 public https source URLs

tools.name: get_japan_web_research
tools.description: Free. Poll an async Japan web-research job by job_id returned from start_japan_web_research.

job_id.description: UUID returned when the job was created

tools.name: start_site_monitor
tools.description: Pay 0.10 USDC to watch a public https URL for 1-7 days (default 7). The Worker checks on your interval (15-360 minutes, default 60), stores text diffs, and can POST an optional webhook when the page changes. Poll with get_site_monitor.

webhook.description: Optional public https URL to POST when the page changes

tools.name: get_site_monitor
tools.description: Free. Poll a site-monitor job by monitor_id returned from start_site_monitor, including stored diffs.

monitor_id.description: UUID returned when the monitor was created

tools.name: list_japan_warning_offices
tools.description: Free list of 58 JMA forecast offices you can query with get_japan_weather_warnings.
